lines.zh: 我八条腿一起动，走得很稳。
lines.en: Eight legs move together and I walk steadily.
My tail is held over my back.
I walk the Underworld's stone.
My pincers open and close.
I stop and lower my tail.
I go around the lava.
My stinger sways above my head.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳在光里发暗红。
lines.en: My shell goes dark red in the light.
I climb the rock face easily.
My legs leave scratches where I pass.

lines.zh: 我伏在石头上，钳子收着。
lines.en: I lie on the stone with my pincers drawn in.
My tail sways slowly.
I am listening to what moves below.
In the dark, my pincers half open.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛看不见什么，可我知道。
lines.en: My eyes see little, yet I know.
This crack in the stone is my burrow.
I raise one pincer.
Ash lies on my shell.
I settle my body onto the stone.

lines.zh: 我伏在深渊里，等脚步声。
lines.en: I lie in the abyss, waiting for footsteps.
My sting glints once.
I have been down here too long.
I have turned slightly.

lines.zh: 脚边的石子被我的腿推开。
lines.en: My legs push the pebbles aside.
I lie still with my pincers on the stone.
I am watching that way.

lines.zh: 我把钳子抬起来，正对着你。
lines.en: I raise my pincers squarely at you.
You are too near my pincers.
My tail rises slowly.
I am judging your weight.
You are warm as a sunlit stone.
My front legs moved an inch closer.
My mouthparts move.
You have no shell on you.

lines.zh: 我看得出你的手在发颤。
lines.en: I can tell your hands are shaking.
One step back from you and I stop.

lines.zh: 我八只眼，一起转你那边。
lines.en: All eight of my eyes turn your way.
I simply hold this path.

lines.zh: 我的壳被打得响了一下。
lines.en: My shell rings once.

lines.zh: 我的八条腿一齐撑住地面。
lines.en: All eight of my legs brace against the ground.

lines.zh: 这一下震得我的腿一颤。
lines.en: That blow shook my legs.
I lower my tail.
One leg fewer, and I still stand.

lines.zh: 我的腿又把我撑起来了。
lines.en: My legs have braced me up again.
My sting clicked once.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳被敲凹了一块。
lines.en: A dent has been knocked into my carapace.
I turn to face you.

lines.zh: 这点敲打，我连裂都没裂。
lines.en: That knock did not even crack me.
This does not smell of anything living.
That little thing of yours, I do not want it.
My pincers have closed.
I turn my head to the rock wall.
Dead things? My pincers will not touch them.
Hold it higher; I still will not look up.
This is too dry for the mouth.
I am not pinching that.
I swept it one glance.
Take it and go.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我的壳纹丝没动。
lines.en: You strike me and my shell does not shift.

lines.zh: 我的钳子朝你的腿伸过去。
lines.en: My pincer reaches for your leg.
That was shrugged off.
Shell meets shell, and I push back.
My legs hold the ground.
You touched my tail again.
I lift a pincer and lower it.
You backed off quickly.
There is a scrape of dust on my shell.
A bump, and I turn toward you.
This shell of mine is not for such things.
I have lived too long.

lines.zh: 我尾钩轻轻敲了两下地。
lines.en: My stinger taps the ground twice.
Only wind answers in the rock.
This body is only for hunting.
I withdraw deeper into the burrow.
I only keep this stone.
I settle back onto the stone.
I am the only one in this pit.
I slowly draw in my pincers.
I lift it in one pincer.
This will not crush.
I crush it.
Light as a scrap of shell.
One flick and it is aside.
I probe it with my mouthparts.
This may be useful.
It is stuck in my pincer.
I push it into a crevice.
I will not keep this.
I raise my tail as high as it goes.
You have walked onto my path.
My whole shell advances on you.
My pincers are fully open.
I roar and the rock answers.

lines.zh: 往前一步，就是我的地盘。
lines.en: One step further is my ground.
Under this stone is mine.
My legs have begun to move.
You have closed your own way back.
I will not chase far, but you will not get out.
My roar makes the rock shake.
This will be slow.
My sting points forward.
There is no shell of yours to stop it.
Out of all of them, you.

lines.zh: 我的毒针抬起来了，跑不掉。
lines.en: My stinger is raised; there is no way out.
I raise both pincers.
Stand still and do not stir.
I follow you on eight steady legs.
You go left; I circle left.
I stay along the base of the wall.
My tail has not come down.
I am not fast, but I am steady.
There is only this path here.
I am behind you.
You can hear my legs.
My tread is getting closer.
You have backed against the rock.

lines.zh: 我张开钳口，能夹断骨头。
lines.en: My pincers open wide enough to snap bone.
The rock groans where I push it.
Every step brings you closer.
I have held this stone a long while.
My shell scrapes the ground.
Only three steps remain.

lines.zh: 你背后的石壁，我替你数过了。
lines.en: I have already counted the rock wall behind you.
I am bringing the sting down.
This step is slow.
The last of the distance.
My pincer clamps your leg.
The sting drives down from above.
I bring a pincer down.
That grip is very tight.
I throw my whole body forward.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，声音压着你。
lines.en: I roar and the sound bears down on you.
That pinch missed.
I raise the tail again.
The blow drove you back.
Venom runs from the sting.

lines.zh: 我转了个身，钳子扫过去。
lines.en: I turn and sweep a pincer.
You have not fallen; good.
My legs brace my body.
I have closed another stretch.
The ground splits first.
I push out from under the stone seam.
My pincers appear first.
Scratches appear on the rock.
My shell glows red in the light.
I slowly raise my body.
I push my body up out of the stone.
I raise my tail over my back.
I am used to the heat here.
I take my place by the stone.

lines.zh: 我听见地底传来一阵震动。
lines.en: I hear a tremor running under the ground.
I have kept watch here a long while.
My tail cuts an arc.

lines.zh: 我在你前面，慢慢转过身体。
lines.en: I am before you and turning slowly.
These stones are mine.
My eight legs begin to crawl.

lines.zh: 我的毒针上凝着一滴毒液。
lines.en: A drop of venom beads on my stinger.
I block the entire path.
There is no other way out.

lines.zh: 我已经到了这块石头上。
lines.en: I have reached this stone.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的壳，我退进石缝。
lines.en: Fire bakes my shell; I back into the crevice.

lines.zh: 我砸在岩上，腿散开又收拢。
lines.en: I hit the rock and my legs splay and gather.
Water seeps into my shell joints; I claw wildly.
The blast flips me shell-down.

lines.zh: 有东西卡在我的节缝里。
lines.en: Something jams between my segments.
Some force pins my legs.
Hunger makes my pincers unsteady.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的壳上，我整个僵了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my shell and I lock up.
There is no rock and nothing to grip.
